operations.name: UpdateHotelInfo
operations.description: PUT /hotel-infos/{hotelId}: validates the city, updates hotel_infos.city, returns the HotelInfo with its room infos, rejects a blank city with 422, and logs 'HotelInfo Updated'.

operations.name: Update HotelInfo Screen
operations.description: Manager form for changing a hotel's city, showing the updated HotelInfo or the rejection reason.

operations.name: UpdateHotelInfoEndpoint
operations.description: FastEndpoints PUT /hotel-infos/{hotelId} with its whitespace-aware city validator. It maps validation failures to the contract's 422 {hotelId, reason} body instead of the FastEndpoints default.

operations.name: UpdateHotelInfoUseCase
operations.description: Trims the city, updates it through the store, and records the structured 'HotelInfo Updated' log event. It also defines the request and response contract types.

operations.name: MongoHotelInfoStore
operations.description: MongoDB access to the hotels model: updates only the city (and updated_at) in hotel_infos, then loads the hotel's room_infos by hotel_id to build the complete HotelInfo.

operations.name: UpdateHotelInfoScreen
operations.description: MUI form with hotel ID and city inputs. It shows the updated HotelInfo and its rooms on success, or the 422 reason as the city field error.

operations.name: updateHotelInfoStore
operations.description: Zustand store for the entered values, submission status, result and error. It blocks duplicate submissions and keeps the inputs after a rejection.

operations.name: UpdateHotelInfo API client
operations.description: Calls PUT /hotel-infos/{hotelId} (URL-encoded ID) against a configurable base URL that defaults to same-origin. Returns either the updated HotelInfo or the 422 rejection.
